## Church leaders

Evaluate your congregation's actual metrics — attendance, giving, online engagement, program participation — against John 13:35: would an outsider watching our dashboards conclude that love is what we optimize? Then consider building something: one congregation-scale proposal from the v1 course imagines a "Love Your Neighbor" platform — members' skills and availability matched to concrete local needs (elderly assistance, childcare for single parents, language practice with immigrants), integrated with local businesses for ethical consumption, with rhythms of shared meals and service — technology that moves a church from passive attendance toward everyday, practical love. Prototype a slice of it, even on a spreadsheet.
